scope: Screen real-LC candidate stationarity before attempting periodic noise.

stationarity.criteria: Last1us: phase pp<.02rad, drift<.01rad/us, cycles/ref errors<.001, ctrl0.2..1V; functional stationarity, not jitter.
stationarity.measurement_limit: Sparse GHz voltage/current samples are not used for RF swing or average power.

boundary: Real LC Q5 and sampled loop, continuous-clock divider candidate; static slow-control boundary. Analog-state text seed; not native continuation, cold start or jitter validation.
